description.en: A precise product reveal built from material transitions, macro lighting, and a final packshot.
description.zh: 用材质转场、微距光线和最终定帧完成精确的产品揭晓。

prompt: Create a 15-second luxury fragrance launch using the bottle in Image 1 as the exact product reference. Preserve the bottle geometry, cap, glass color, label position, and all legible packaging text. Open with an extreme macro shot of condensation traveling across black glass. Follow one droplet as it falls and transforms into a ribbon of liquid chrome. The ribbon crosses a dark stone surface, reveals the bottle through reflected light, and becomes a narrow spotlight behind it. Time the transformation beats to Audio 1. Camera movement is slow, architectural, and physically plausible. Lighting is graphite black with cold cyan highlights and one warm amber edge. Finish with a stable centered packshot for two seconds. No hands, extra bottles, invented copy, floating logos, or deformed packaging.
